title: Website: Spotify Matching Site
pitch: Matches you with a friend based on how similar your Spotify listening history is.
description: A website that matches users with a friend based on shared taste in their Spotify listening history, built with a team of five for Web Development III during my bachelor's degree. The app compares listening data between users and pairs people whose music taste overlaps, with a React frontend and an Express/Socket.io backend handling real-time chat between matches.
